messages:
Emily (Partnerships): heads-up — creating a lightweight handoff rule for SI co-sell leads coming from the cloud marketplace. can we align quickly?
Raj (Sales): yes pls. what's the trigger? marketplace lead vs field-sourced?
Emily (Partnerships): marketplace-marked leads should follow standard intake, but if SI is attached (checkbox) then follow the SI claim rules. proposal: SI claims when 1) ARR >= $50k OR 2) strategic industry match + region overlap.
Lina (Account Mgmt): clarify: if ARR is $40k and SI is the one who demoed, do we still let AM intervene?
Omar (SI Ops): i'd say yes — put a soft-claim window: SI has 72h to accept; if they accept, they own outreach but AM stays CC'd. if they don't accept, it routes back to AM.
Raj (Sales): 72h seems fine. also: what about territory conflicts? e.g., SI owns the account but sales rep in another region.
Emily (Partnerships): add rule: tie ownership to primary account mapping in SFDC. if SFDC owner != SI owner, ops-run reconciliation step before claim finalization.
Sam (Product): can we enforce this with a webhook from marketplace -> intake queue? I'd rather avoid manual steps.
Omar (SI Ops): we can. simple flow: marketplace payload -> intake lambda -> check ARR & SFDC owner -> create claim task with TTL 72h -> notify SI slack channel + AM. we already have the lambda for HW partner claims, reuse.
Emily (Partnerships): perfect — add a note: for hardware partner-originated leads (HW partner portal) treat the same as marketplace for claim logic but tag as HW so reporting separates them.
Lina (Account Mgmt): SLA question: when SI accepts, do they get commit levels? like commit to joint demo within 5 biz days?
Raj (Sales): recommend 5 biz days for intro/demo cadence, with auto-reminder at 48h and escalation to AM at 72h if no demo scheduled.
Emily (Partnerships): agreed. i'll draft the short playbook bullets: claim conditions, 72h accept window, 5 biz day demo commit, SFDC reconciliation, HW vs marketplace tagging, reporting fields.
Sam (Product): is there an edge-case for POCs where SI wants to own the POC but we need usage on Dedicated? need a fallback plan for infra commitments.
Omar (SI Ops): add fallback: infra gating check during claim — if Dedicated/private infra required, notify infra-sales and block claim until capacity + commercial ok. mark as "infra-dependent".
Lina (Account Mgmt): please add a sample ownership note for SFDC so AMs know how to tag: `SI_Partner__c`, `SI_Claimed__c`, `Claim_TTL__c`.
Emily (Partnerships): on it. also planning a joint announcement workflow: if SI co-sell leads to joint PR or marketplace listing, require partner comms sign-off + legal checklist before public mention.
Raj (Sales): who owns partner comms sign-off? Partnerships?
Emily (Partnerships): yes — partnerships + legal. i'll own the checklist.
Omar (SI Ops): tagging request: when SI accepts claim, trigger `#si-claims` slack thread and post a short stub with lead id, ARR, SFDC link, owner. can we standardize format?
Sam (Product): format suggestion: `LeadID | ARR | Region | SFDC link | Next action (demo by DATE)` — machine-parsable helps downstream tooling.
Lina (Account Mgmt): +1. please include `PartnerTier` (Gold/Silver/Bronze) and `Source` (marketplace/HW/field).
Emily (Partnerships): i'll draft the playbook doc and post here by EOD. quick action items:
- Emily: draft playbook + sample SFDC note (EOD)
- Omar: add intake lambda task + slack post template (end of week)
- Sam: add webhook spec for marketplace payloads (mid-week)
- Raj/Lina: validate SLA timelines with sales ops (tomorrow)
jen-deploy-bot: deploy pipeline check: intake-lambda tests passed in staging ✅
Raj (Sales): nice. thanks team.
Lina (Account Mgmt): will review once doc is up.
Emily (Partnerships): thanks — will @everyone when posted. :raised_hands:
